description_en: A biomass pre-processor for a small biofuel plant should accept more kinds of feedstock, including woody brush. Doing so needs extra cutting stations, so the machine gets more parts and becomes more complex.
source_citation: WIPO, Toolkit on New Product Development and Inventions in the Public Domain, Tool 13: TRIZ, 2024 (biofuels mini-refinery example)
notes: Matrix cell 26x36 = 3;13;27;10. The source names no principles for this pair; the pair itself is explicit (feature numbers given).

description_en: Handling a wider range of biomass types (larger, tougher material) in the pre-processor requires more cutting work, which increases the energy consumed by the moving machine parts.
source_citation: WIPO, Toolkit on New Product Development and Inventions in the Public Domain, Tool 13: TRIZ, 2024 (biofuels mini-refinery example)
notes: Matrix cell 26x19 = 34;29;16;18. The source names no principles for this pair; the pair itself is explicit (feature numbers given).

description_en: Letting the pre-processor take a broader variety of feedstock calls for a more powerful drive, so power demand rises.
source_citation: WIPO, Toolkit on New Product Development and Inventions in the Public Domain, Tool 13: TRIZ, 2024 (biofuels mini-refinery example)
notes: Matrix cell 26x21 = 35, weakly attested (3 of 4 transcriptions agree). The source names no principles; the pair is explicit and the prose-to-Power mapping is the source own. Pair is reliable, cell is not.

description_en: Reducing the mass of a tire-building drum (by changing materials) lowers the load on its support shaft, but may impair other mechanical properties and shorten component life.
source_citation: Stevko, Kohar, Cechmanek, Medvecka, Novy: Optimization of the Tire Building Drum for Passenger Tires Using the TRIZ Methodology. Management Systems in Production Engineering 31(3), 2023, pp. 361-372, DOI 10.2478/mspe-2023-0040
notes: Cell 1x12 = 10;14;35;40, identical to the table of the authors. The prose (worsening = durability and other properties) does not clearly match parameter 12 Shape; the parameter choice is the authors. Noisy label.

description_en: Strengthening the shaft of the tire-building drum by reducing the load on it is meant to improve tire symmetry and drum productivity, while the service life of parts could suffer.
source_citation: Stevko, Kohar, Cechmanek, Medvecka, Novy: Optimization of the Tire Building Drum for Passenger Tires Using the TRIZ Methodology. Management Systems in Production Engineering 31(3), 2023, pp. 361-372, DOI 10.2478/mspe-2023-0040
notes: Cell 14x39 = 29;35;10;14, identical to the table of the authors. The stated worsening (service life) fits Durability better than parameter 39 Productivity. Noisy label.
